newsitem.title: UK: UK's DFS says confident of continuing growth.
newsitem.headline: UK's DFS says confident of continuing growth.

text.p: British furniture superstore operator DFS Furniture Plc, reporting a 23.6 percent jump in pretax profits to 18.7 million pounds ($30.5 million) for the six months to January 25, on Tuesday said it was confident of continued growth.

"I am confident and optimistic about the long term and look forward to reporting continuing growth and success at the outcome of the full," said executive chairman Sir Graham Kirkham in a statement accompanying the results.

DFS suffered a setback in its share price in early March after rival MFI Furniture Group Plc posted a surprise slowdown in sales growth and warned that its market had not yet sees a sustained pickup in demand.

However, after reporting a high 43.9 percent surge in sales in the first half of the latest financial year to 126.3 million pounds, Kirkham was confident of the group's trading prospects despite the current state of the market.
"These excellent results clearly show, once again, our ability to deliver consistent profit growth without significant improvement in trading conditions," said Kirkham.

He said the results were achieved in a generally flat market and underlined the success of its expansion into the London area over the past financial year. Having opened three new stores in London and five others elsewhere in the previous year, together with a further two in the latest half year, DFS is to continue with its planned expansion, Kirkham added.
